decks.name: LeetCode #155 - Min Stack
decks.description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time

cards.question: Min Stack: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time. Implement the MinStack class: MinStack() initializes the stack object. void push(int val) pushes the element val onto the stack. void pop() removes the element on the top of the stack. int top() gets the top element of the stack. int getMin() retrieves the minimum element in the stack. You must implement a solution with O(1) time complexity for each function.

solutions.name: Two Stacks
solutions.explanation: Maintain two stacks: one for actual values and one for minimum values. When pushing, also push the current minimum onto the minStack. When popping, pop from both stacks. This keeps track of the minimum at each level, allowing O(1) getMin operations.

solutions.name: One Stack
solutions.explanation: Use a single stack that stores the difference between the current value and the current minimum. Track the minimum separately. When pushing, if the new value is less than min, update min and store a negative difference. When popping a negative value, restore the previous min. This saves space but is more complex.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: Use a single stack for storing values. For getMin, scan through the entire stack to find the minimum. This makes getMin O(n) but saves the space of maintaining a separate minimum tracking structure. Inefficient for frequent getMin operations.
